title: Create a blog post
description: As a logged-in blogger, I want to write a blog post as plain text with a title and tags, so that my notes are stored with the right metadata.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a logged-in user on 'My Blogs', when they click 'New post', then a form with Title, Content and Tags fields is shown.
The Author field on the New post form is pre-filled with the logged-in user's display name and cannot be edited.
When the user fills Title and Content and clicks 'Publish', the post is saved and appears at the top of 'My Blogs' with today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
When the user clicks 'Publish' without a Title, the message 'Title is required' is shown and the post is not saved.
